[b]Inaugural Game of the 2027 Lagonda Toqabileh Premier League[/b]

The Inaugural game of the 2027 Lagonda Toqabileh Premier League (TAL) was held at 21:00 6 October with Karamay United hosting Uzungyllinish at Balasaghuni Stadium, Orqu District of Karamay. This game marks the 12th Season of TAL, and the first with Lagonda Automotives as a major sponsor of the league. Karamay United and Uzungyllinish were both founded in 2027 as part of TALs expansion following the Lagonda Automotives sponsorship. 

The game ended after Uzungyllinish was able to beat the 108 runs set by Karamay United in the first innings, granting Uzungyllinish its first win while simultaneously handing Karamay United its first defeat in both of the teams histories.

[b]Match 1  6 October 2027 21:00 (Local time), Balasaghuni Stadium, Orqu[/b]

Karamay United  108/10 (20)
[b]Uzungyllinish  109/4 (20)[/b]

[b]Player records[/b]

[b]Karamay United[/b]  Khidr Khan 38 (40)  Imad Wasim 3/15
[b]Uzungyllinish[/b]  Liyas Koja 33 (32)  Iftikar Ehmed 2/12
